standing_rules: At chat/resume start read RULES.MD on main and CHAT_SESSION_STATE.json on chat-session-state, then verify live refs/issues.
GitHub is the development control plane; OpenVMS V9.2-3 x86-64 is canonical native acceptance authority.
Make development/source edits in GitHub on the milestone branch; use OpenVMS for exact-SHA native validation.
Omit literal OVMS-AGENT> from commands supplied for paste.
Use maximum practical work per cut and paste; split only when an intermediate result must be inspected for safety/evidence.
Use GITAUTH for authenticated raw Git network operations; keep core.filemode=false.
Do not trust OpenVMS Git porcelain alone when RMS/materialization evidence matters.
Close individual defect issues immediately after deterministic coverage plus canonical native acceptance.

When product/build/runtime inputs change, canonical native acceptance requires All regression tests passed., Build completed successfully., and BUILD_STATUS=%X00000001 plus focused regressions as needed.
Exact-SHA acceptance and tree-equivalent promotion are distinct facts; promoted merge SHA itself must be built before calling it native-green.
Keep main and chat-session-state permanently; retain only the two most recently completed milestone development branches unless unique unpromoted work or an explicit no-promotion exception applies.
Do not invent an mNNN tag for a stress-only milestone with no canonical promoted main; record and prune it only after proving the branch contains no unique work.
